en.headline: Cathay Pacific first-half profit rises 71% to HK$6.24 billion
en.dek: The group posted its strongest interim result since 2010 on solid passenger and cargo demand, declaring a first interim dividend of 26 HK cents per share.
body: Cathay Pacific Airways reported an attributable profit of HK$6.24 billion for the six months ended 30 June 2026, up 71 per cent from HK$3.7 billion a year earlier, the company said on Wednesday.

Group revenue rose 25.3 per cent to HK$68.06 billion. The result included non-recurring gains of about HK$1 billion, mainly a non-cash deemed partial disposal gain of roughly HK$1.4 billion from the dilution of its equity interest in Air China Limited.

Airlines and subsidiaries contributed an attributable profit of HK$4.9 billion, while associates added HK$410 million. Cathay Group Chair Guy Bradley said the performance reflected ongoing demand for Cathay Pacific and Cathay Cargo, improved results from HK Express and stronger associate contributions, despite jet-fuel costs almost doubling between the first and second quarters because of Middle East tensions.

The board declared a first interim dividend of 26 HK cents per ordinary share, totalling HK$1.6 billion and representing a 30 per cent increase on the corresponding payment last year. Bradley said the group remains cautiously optimistic for the rest of the year, subject to developments in the Middle East and other macroeconomic factors, and has already committed around HK$150 billion to fleet, cabin, lounge and digital investments.

zh.headline: 國泰上半年溢利升71%至62.4億元
zh.dek: 集團錄得2010年以來最強中期業績，乘客及貨運需求穩健，宣布派發第一次中期股息每股26港仙。
body: 國泰航空周三公布，截至2026年6月30日止六個月，應佔溢利62.4億元，較去年同期37億元上升71%。
集團收入升25.3%至680.6億元。業績包括約10億元非經常性收入，主要來自所持中國國航權益攤薄產生的約14億元非現金視作部分出售盈利。
航空公司及附屬公司貢獻應佔溢利49億元，聯屬公司則錄得4.1億元。國泰集團主席白遠勤表示，業績受國泰及國泰貨運持續需求、香港快運表現改善及聯屬公司貢獻較強所帶動，儘管中東局勢令第二季航油成本幾乎較第一季倍增。
董事會宣布派發第一次中期股息每股普通股26港仙，合共16億元，按年增加30%。白遠勤指集團對下半年審慎樂觀，視乎中東發展及其他宏觀因素，並已承諾約1500億元投資於機隊、客艙、貴賓室及數碼創新。
